records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.138:CAPUT	São anuláveis os negócios jurídicos, quando as declarações de vontade emanarem de erro substancial que poderia ser percebido por pessoa de diligência normal, em face das circunstâncias do negócio.
records.independent_rule_summary: A substantial, objectively recognizable error makes the transaction voidable, not automatically void.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.143:CAPUT	O erro de cálculo apenas autoriza a retificação da declaração de vontade.
records.independent_rule_summary: A merely arithmetical error permits correction of the declaration rather than avoidance of the transaction.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.235:CAPUT	Deteriorada a coisa, não sendo o devedor culpado, poderá o credor resolver a obrigação, ou aceitar a coisa, abatido de seu preço o valor que perdeu.
records.independent_rule_summary: Fortuitous deterioration of a certain thing lets the creditor resolve or accept it with proportional price reduction; fault invokes art. 236.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.241:CAPUT	Se, no caso do art. 238, sobrevier melhoramento ou acréscimo à coisa, sem despesa ou trabalho do devedor, lucrará o credor, desobrigado de indenização.
records.independent_rule_summary: A costless improvement to a thing to be returned benefits the creditor without indemnity; debtor-funded improvement follows art. 242.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.286:CAPUT	O credor pode ceder o seu crédito, se a isso não se opuser a natureza da obrigação, a lei, ou a convenção com o devedor; a cláusula proibitiva da cessão não poderá ser oposta ao cessionário de boa-fé, se não constar do instrumento da obrigação.
records.independent_rule_summary: Credit assignment is allowed unless nature, law or agreement bars it; a non-assignment clause affects a good-faith assignee only if in the instrument.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.302:CAPUT	O novo devedor não pode opor ao credor as exceções pessoais que competiam ao devedor primitivo.
records.independent_rule_summary: The assuming debtor cannot invoke defenses personal to the original debtor, while objective defenses of the debt may remain.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.424:CAPUT	Nos contratos de adesão, são nulas as cláusulas que estipulem a renúncia antecipada do aderente a direito resultante da natureza do negócio.
records.independent_rule_summary: An adhesion clause prospectively waiving a right inherent to the transaction is void; the rest of the contract is not automatically void.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot:
CC2002:ART.468:CAPUT	Essa indicação deve ser comunicada à outra parte no prazo de cinco dias da conclusão do contrato, se outro não tiver sido estipulado.
CC2002:ART.468:PAR.UNICO	A aceitação da pessoa nomeada não será eficaz se não se revestir da mesma forma que as partes usaram para o contrato.
records.independent_rule_summary: Nomination is communicated within five days unless otherwise set, and the nominee's acceptance must use the original contract's form.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.585:CAPUT	Se duas ou mais pessoas forem simultaneamente comodatárias de uma coisa, ficarão solidariamente responsáveis para com o comodante.
records.independent_rule_summary: Simultaneous borrowers are jointly liable to the lender for obligations from the shared gratuitous loan.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot:
CC2002:ART.698:CAPUT	Se do contrato de comissão constar a cláusula del credere , responderá o comissário solidariamente com as pessoas com que houver tratado em nome do comitente, caso em que, salvo estipulação em contrário, o comissário tem direito a remuneração mais elevada, para compensar o ônus assumido.
CC2002:ART.698:PAR.UNICO	A cláusula del credere de que trata o caput deste artigo poderá ser parcial. (Incluído Lei nº 14.690, de 2023) Vigência
records.independent_rule_summary: A total or partial del credere clause creates joint liability and presumptively higher remuneration unless otherwise agreed.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.807:CAPUT	O contrato de constituição de renda requer escritura pública.
records.independent_rule_summary: A contract constituting an annuity requires a public deed as a validity formality.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.887:CAPUT	O título de crédito, documento necessário ao exercício do direito literal e autônomo nele contido, somente produz efeito quando preencha os requisitos da lei.
records.independent_rule_summary: A credit instrument is literal and autonomous and has effect only if statutory formal requirements are met.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot:
CC2002:ART.982:CAPUT	Salvo as exceções expressas, considera-se empresária a sociedade que tem por objeto o exercício de atividade própria de empresário sujeito a registro (art. 967); e, simples, as demais.
CC2002:ART.982:PAR.UNICO	Independentemente de seu objeto, considera-se empresária a sociedade por ações; e, simples, a cooperativa.
records.independent_rule_summary: Business/simple classification follows entrepreneurial activity, with mandatory exceptions for corporations and cooperatives.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.990:CAPUT	Todos os sócios respondem solidária e ilimitadamente pelas obrigações sociais, excluído do benefício de ordem, previsto no art. 1.024, aquele que contratou pela sociedade.
records.independent_rule_summary: Partners in an unregistered partnership have unlimited joint liability; the contracting partner lacks benefit of prior execution.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.1097:CAPUT	Consideram-se coligadas as sociedades que, em suas relações de capital, são controladas, filiadas, ou de simples participação, na forma dos artigos seguintes.
records.independent_rule_summary: Affiliation covers controlled, affiliated or simple-participation capital relationships; reciprocal ownership is not required by the text.
records.comparison: CC art. 1.097 refers to capital relationships of control, affiliation or simple participation, not necessarily reciprocal participation.

finding.problematic_excerpt: quando sua participação recíproca se enquadra
finding.legal_basis: CC art. 1.097 refers to capital relationships of control, affiliation or simple participation, not necessarily reciprocal participation.
finding.legal_or_pedagogical_consequence: May teach mutual ownership as a necessary element of affiliation.
finding.correction_direction: Replace reciprocal participation with capital relationship and defer categories to arts. 1.098-1.100.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.1108:CAPUT	Pago o passivo e partilhado o remanescente, convocará o liquidante assembléia dos sócios para a prestação final de contas.
records.independent_rule_summary: After liabilities are paid and remainder divided, the liquidator must convene the partners for final accounts.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.1217:CAPUT	O possuidor de boa-fé não responde pela perda ou deterioração da coisa, a que não der causa.
records.independent_rule_summary: A good-faith possessor is not liable for loss/deterioration not caused by that possessor.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.1343:CAPUT	A construção de outro pavimento, ou, no solo comum, de outro edifício, destinado a conter novas unidades imobiliárias, depende da aprovação da unanimidade dos condôminos.
records.independent_rule_summary: A new floor/building creating units on common land requires unanimous condominium approval.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.1496:CAPUT	Se tiver dúvida sobre a legalidade do registro requerido, o oficial fará, ainda assim, a prenotação do pedido. Se a dúvida, dentro em noventa dias, for julgada improcedente, o registro efetuar-se-á com o mesmo número que teria na data da prenotação; no caso contrário, cancelada esta, receberá o registro o número correspondente à data em que se tornar a requerer.
records.independent_rule_summary: Registration doubt does not prevent prenotation; favorable decision within 90 days preserves priority, otherwise a renewed filing gets a new number.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.1503:CAPUT	Os credores hipotecários não podem embaraçar a exploração da linha, nem contrariar as modificações, que a administração deliberar, no leito da estrada, em suas dependências, ou no seu material.
records.independent_rule_summary: Railway mortgage creditors cannot obstruct operation or administration-approved changes to track, dependencies or equipment.

records.current_law_snapshot:
CC2002:ART.1673:CAPUT	Integram o patrimônio próprio os bens que cada cônjuge possuía ao casar e os por ele adquiridos, a qualquer título, na constância do casamento.
CC2002:ART.1673:PAR.UNICO	A administração desses bens é exclusiva de cada cônjuge, que os poderá livremente alienar, se forem móveis.
records.independent_rule_summary: Under final participation, each spouse's own assets include pre- and post-marriage acquisitions, with exclusive management and free disposal of movables.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.1710:CAPUT	As prestações alimentícias, de qualquer natureza, serão atualizadas segundo índice oficial regularmente estabelecido. SUBTÍTULO IV Do Bem de Família
records.independent_rule_summary: All maintenance payments are updated by a regularly established official index; adjustment differs from substantive revision.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.1743:CAPUT	Se os bens e interesses administrativos exigirem conhecimentos técnicos, forem complexos, ou realizados em lugares distantes do domicílio do tutor, poderá este, mediante aprovação judicial, delegar a outras pessoas físicas ou jurídicas o exercício parcial da tutela.
records.independent_rule_summary: Technical, complex or distant management may be partially delegated to a person/entity only with judicial approval.
records.comparison: The five ENTENDA fields preserve the independently stated rule, its material limitation and legal consequence without an identified contradiction in this review scope.

records.current_law_snapshot:
CC2002:ART.1765:CAPUT	O tutor é obrigado a servir por espaço de dois anos.
CC2002:ART.1765:PAR.UNICO	Pode o tutor continuar no exercício da tutela, além do prazo previsto neste artigo, se o quiser e o juiz julgar conveniente ao menor.
records.independent_rule_summary: Tutor serves two years and may continue only if willing and the judge finds continuation convenient for the minor.
records.comparison: CC art. 1.765 sole paragraph requires both the tutor's willingness and the judge's convenience finding.

finding.problematic_excerpt: podendo continuar se o juiz considerar conveniente ao menor
finding.legal_basis: CC art. 1.765 sole paragraph requires both the tutor's willingness and the judge's convenience finding.
finding.legal_or_pedagogical_consequence: Suggests judicial convenience alone can compel continuation beyond the two-year term.
finding.correction_direction: Express the tutor's willingness and judicial assessment as cumulative conditions.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.1874:CAPUT	Depois de aprovado e cerrado, será o testamento entregue ao testador, e o tabelião lançará, no seu livro, nota do lugar, dia, mês e ano em que o testamento foi aprovado e entregue.
records.independent_rule_summary: The closed will returns to the testator and the notary records place and full date of approval/delivery.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.1985:CAPUT	O encargo da testamentaria não se transmite aos herdeiros do testamenteiro, nem é delegável; mas o testamenteiro pode fazer-se representar em juízo e fora dele, mediante mandatário com poderes especiais.
records.independent_rule_summary: Executorship is personal, non-heritable and nondelegable, but special-power representation is allowed.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.2036:CAPUT	A locação de prédio urbano, que esteja sujeita à lei especial, por esta continua a ser regida.

records.current_law_snapshot: CC2002:ART.2044:CAPUT	Este Código entrará em vigor 1 (um) ano após a sua publicação.
